info.title: Pengine Local API
info.description: Local-only API for persona selection, observable asynchronous short-drama creation, timeout and final-review recovery, complete result retrieval, and one frozen revision.

post.summary: Queue an initial complete creation run

value.story: 一个离开故乡多年的人回乡处理旧屋。
value.requirements: 创作一部当代短剧；具体集数和单集标准从所选人格的 L4 获取。

get.summary: Get initial and revision states and complete results

post.summary: Freeze and queue the only revision, or requeue its identical feedback after failure
post.description: The first accepted feedback is frozen. A failed revision may be requeued only with byte-for-byte identical feedback. Queued, running, or succeeded revisions reject this command.

value.feedback: 主角最后的选择太顺利，请让代价更明确，同时保留原有情绪底色。

409.description: Idempotency conflict, revision unavailable, or feedback differs from the frozen feedback

post.summary: Continue a paused initial or revision run

202.description: Run queued or an identical continue command replayed

post.summary: Retry a rejected L0 or L4 final review
post.description: Queues the same quality_rejected run unless that gate has exhausted its three-attempt limit. Durable checkpoints and drafts remain unchanged; the worker re-executes only the rejected final-review gate. An identical idempotency key replays its prior accepted response.

202.description: Final review queued or an identical accepted retry command replayed

409.description: The requested run cannot retry final review

post.summary: Authorize exactly one generation-plus-review cycle for a repair
post.description: Grants the pending repair authorization bound to the active lineage and queues the run for exactly one cycle. A failure returns to the same evidence pause without automatic repetition. Generic Continue cannot spend a content-repair budget.

409.description: The requested run cannot be authorized

post.summary: End a paused or quality-rejected initial or revision run permanently

202.description: Run ended or an identical end command replayed

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A caller-generated key. Reuse with the same request replays the original command response; reuse with a different request returns idempotency_conflict.

example.message: One or more request fields are invalid.
The requested persona is not selectable.
The requested creation does not exist.

IdempotencyConflict.description: Idempotency key reused with a different request

example.message: The idempotency key is already bound to a different request.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Local service cannot accept the command

design.description: The latest deterministically valid unfinished SeriesBible design candidate for this run. Every projection and hash belongs to one candidate; the design package is never formal delivery.

SeriesBibleSummary.description: Durable API/UI projection of the latest active design candidate.

RepairAuthorization.title: RepairAuthorization
RepairAuthorization.description:
The exact one-cycle repair authorization shown at a repair-authorization pause.

It binds the active lineage and carries the review evidence, the affected
range, and the estimated token requirement so the operator can decide between
``authorize once`` and ``end and preserve workspace`` (RPR-A8/A9).
